staticText: Local-first French phrasebook with 95 embedded rows: 75 general-French learning rows and 20 rows labelled African French. Search and filtered export cover all labelled rows; the session-only quiz deliberately uses only the 75 general rows.
boundaries: Do not generalise this vocabulary set across Francophone Africa.
Country, community, profession, generation and formal or informal register boundaries must be established per entry; missing boundaries remain unknown or unverified.
The 20 African-French-labelled rows are excluded from quiz answers because their country and register provenance is missing.
Synthetic browser speech is not verified pronunciation for any country, community or register.
Optional external translation requires explicit, non-persistent page-session consent and local phrasebook use remains available without it.
Never place raw source or translated text in browser persistence, URLs, analytics, accounts, email, logs or caches.
